scripts.android:build: bun run build && CI=true cap sync android && mise exec -- ./android/gradlew -p android :app:assembleDebug
scripts.android:release: bun run build && CI=true cap sync android && mise exec -- ./android/gradlew -p android :app:assembleRelease
scripts.android:run: bun run android:build && adb install -r android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk && adb shell am start -n com.michael.teneo.debug/com.michael.teneo.MainActivity
scripts.android:dev: adb reverse tcp:5175 tcp:5175 && CI=true TENEO_LIVE_RELOAD_URL=http://localhost:5175 cap sync android && mise exec -- ./android/gradlew -p android :app:assembleDebug && adb install -r android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk && adb shell am start -n com.michael.teneo.debug/com.michael.teneo.MainActivity
